action.message:
Index Data Explorer installed successfully.

What was done:
- Repo at /workspace (commit a8c4210). It is a static HTML/JS web app (no build step), so installation = serve the toplevel folders via a web server. No package-manager deps (package.json is just {"type":"module"}); externalPackages/, src/, i18n/, config/, php/ are all vendored.
- Installed prerequisites via apt: nginx 1.18.0 and python3 (nginx chosen as the documented WebServer).
- Created nginx site /etc/nginx/sites-available/daexp listening on :8080 with root /workspace and index index.html, enabled it, removed the default site, validated config (nginx -t OK), and started nginx (master PID 1328).
- Document root is the project toplevel, so index.html, csvParse.html, plausibilityCheck.html, elasticsearchIndexAdministration.html and all examples/* HTML pages are directly reachable and resolve relative imports.

Verification:
- HTTP 200 for index.html, all referenced JS/CSS (materialize, d3, leaflet, markercluster, flatpickr), the src/js ES modules, config/baseConfig.json and i18n/en.json.
- HTTP 200 for example pages (kosis/komono).
- Running nginx (master + workers) confirmed.
- Access point: http://localhost:8080/index.html (or /examples/kosis/kosisDemo.html etc.).

Notes / unknown state:
- config points to http://localhost:9200 as the Elasticsearch base URL. No Elasticsearch service was installed, so the UI loads but cannot query data until an Elasticsearch instance is reachable (or config/proxy is set). This is a runtime data dependency, not a code installation issue.
